answer: Audits are entered in ocean, queued in voyage, and horizon publishes the wait time. A farm of 106 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 44 identities per epoch. A farm of 1367 identities would post 3140 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
